name: vayusense
description: VayuSense — GenAI-powered urban air quality assistant for families and communities. Personalized low-emission routines, indoor air hacks and sustainable swaps with measurable impact.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @vayusense/shared && npm run build -w @vayusense/functions && npm run build -w @vayusense/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @vayusense/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.deploy:hosting: npm run build && firebase deploy --only hosting
